title: New Treatment Strategies and Epigenetic Biomarker for Management of Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia
official: A Phase 2b Randomized, Single-Center, Double Blind, Placebo Controlled, 2-Arm Study to Investigate Orally Administered Combination Therapies (5-alpha Reductase Inhibitor + Raloxifene) Compared With Monotherapy (5-alpha Reductase Inhibitor + Placebo) in Adult Patients With Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH)
summary: SRD5A2 is a critical enzyme for prostatic development and growth, and the SRD5A2 inhibitor, finasteride, is used to treat benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). SRD5A2 is absent in 30% of normal adult men, which explains the resistance of a subset of patients to this commonly prescribed drug. This project proposes new combination therapies (5-ARI+raloxifene) and evaluates novel non-invasive biomarkers, based on alternative pathways that lead to prostatic enlargement.
